title: DecisionEnvelope
description: The immutable, append-only record of ONE policy decision (spec §6.6 / §5.5 immutable-decision invariant). Emitted by the deterministic policy reducer (CP1), NOT by a model — the reducer is the sole enforcement authority (§5.3). A decision is valid only for the EXACT artifact, task, rubric, policy, verifier set, reviewer model, prompt, and environment recorded in the governance/subject/inputs hashes here (§2.1 goal 8). Corrections never rewrite this row: they append a NEW envelope that `supersedes` it, and a material-input change appends a DECISION_INVALIDATED event referencing it (§12.3). The `idempotency_key` collapses byte-identical re-decisions to one row (§20.1.7); `sequence_no` gives monotonic causal order. Content-addressed refs make the decision replayable (§12.4): reconstruct the reviewed package, rerun reduction, and audit which input change invalidated approval.

schema_version.description: Artifact schema version (semver). Optional on emission — stamped by the emission layer.

decision_event_id.description: Unique id for this decision event.

sequence_no.description: Monotonic sequence number in the append-only ledger (causal ordering, spec §12.1).

idempotency_key.description: Content hash over the material decision inputs. Two reductions on identical material inputs share this key and collapse to one row (idempotent, §20.1.7). Any material-input change yields a different key = a distinct decision.

subject.description: Content-addressed identity of what was decided.

specification_hash.description: sha256 of the task spec / acceptance criteria.

candidate_package_hash.description: sha256 of the CandidatePackage shown to the reviewer (replay anchor, §12.4).

governance.description: Content addresses of the governance artifacts in force at decision time. A change to any of these invalidates the decision (§12.3).

policy_hash.description: Hash of the versioned enforcement policy the reducer applied (CP1's policy artifact).

inputs.description: Content addresses of the typed artifacts the reduction consumed.

review_decision_hash.description: Hash of the ReviewDecision fed to the reducer (may be absent for no-review fast-path decisions).

verification_report_hash.description: Hash of the VerificationReport fed to the reducer.

calibration.description: The cohort-scoped calibration snapshot (spec §11) that governed reviewer authority for this decision. EMPIRICAL risk — NOT raw model confidence (§5.4).

cohort_id.description: Calibration cohort (domain:architect:reviewer:quant:context-band:...) — decisions are never pooled across materially different conditions (§11.2).

estimated_error_rate.description: Empirical decision-error rate for the cohort.

upper_risk_bound.description: Conservative upper confidence bound on risk — compared against the profile threshold to grant/deny authority (§11.4).

policy_result.description: The system action the reducer produced (spec §8). This — not any model output — is the enforced decision.

action.description: Enforced action. continue/replan/rework/defer/escalate/abort per §6.6; collect_evidence + advisory per the §8 reducer branches.

blocking_reason_codes.description: Machine-readable reason codes (e.g. CONCLUSIVE_HIGH_SEVERITY_FAILURE, CONFLICTING_AUTHORITATIVE_EVIDENCE, VERIFIER_OPERATIONAL_ERROR).

validity.description: Supersession + invalidation lineage (append-only — populated at write time; never back-edited onto a prior row, §5.5).

supersedes.description: decision_event_id this decision replaces (an appeal / re-review), or null.

invalidated_by.description: decision_event_id or invalidation-event id that invalidated THIS decision, or null. Authoritative invalidation lives in the DECISION_INVALIDATED event log; this field is a convenience pointer set only when known at write time.

valid_until_material_change.description: True = this decision holds only until any material input changes (the default runtime-assurance contract).
